notes.title: Small Patch: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changed the wording on the customization label in the level select menu.
 Changed the wording on the unlocks panel in the level select menu.
 Added a field that displays to players that they can unlock ship customization after reaching level 2.
 Added a field that displays to players that they can unlock the Rogue-like game mode after reaching level 5.
